text: A purple-toned office chair with a green seat cushion and wheeled base slowly rotates in place, turning from facing the desk to angling more toward the viewer, in a modern living room setting. The background remains completely still, featuring a dark gray sectional sofa with decorative pillows, a large panoramic cityscape painting on the gray wall, a wooden tripod floor lamp with a black shade, a yellow fabric ottoman, a glass-topped coffee table with a small plant, and a desk with an adjustable lamp. Only the office chair moves.
